description: Old to new texts of the wording pass (docs/sow2/design-wording.md). Used by scripts/regress-compare.mjs --text-map: only these changes are allowed to differ between a before run and an after run.

behavior_mismatch.old: The function exists, but its result did not satisfy this check's assertion. See detail.
behavior_mismatch.new: The function exists, but what it returned or changed did not match what this check expects. See detail.

security_finding.old: The scenario this check runs on a temporary copy of the vault was not handled as expected. See detail.
security_finding.new: This check ran a scenario on a temporary copy of the vault and flagged the result. This applies to that scenario only, not to the vault as a whole. See detail.

unclassified_error.old: A call failed for a reason the tool could not classify. Not a finding about the vault. See raw_error.
unclassified_error.new: A call failed for a reason the tool could not classify. Not a finding about the vault. See detail. raw_error holds the error text when the CLI printed any, and is absent when it printed none.

constructor_mismatch.old: The vault's constructor does not take (name, symbol, asset, decimals_offset), so the temporary copy could not be deployed. Not a finding about the vault.
constructor_mismatch.new: The vault's constructor does not accept the arguments (name, symbol, asset, decimals_offset) under these names, so the temporary copy could not be deployed. Not a finding about the vault.

token_interface_mismatch.old: approve or allowance is not declared in a form this check can call (address, address, i128, u32 with spender second). Not a finding about the vault.
token_interface_mismatch.new: approve or allowance cannot be called by this check. It needs approve(address, address, i128, u32) and allowance(address, address), the second argument of each named spender, and a readable contract spec. Not a finding about the vault.

detail.new: In this scenario the vault held up —

detail.old: rounding direction confirmed to always favor the vault over the user
detail.new: at this ratio, rounding favored the vault in both directions tested
deposited $1 units of the underlying asset, minted
withdrew $1 units of the underlying asset, burned

detail.old: which appears to be insufficient balance on the account paying for it
detail.new: because the account paying for it holds less than the call needed
